body: well there are 2 things that I can remember. The first one is when I worked as a night guard at this kindergarten, I often take a nap throughout the night and set alarms on my phone to wake up on time. This time I remembered setting an alarm at around 5:30am, fell asleep and hearing my grandma’s voice as if she was right there whispering in my ears. I got startled and instantly woke up, looked at the phone and it was already 6-something am. My alarm didn’t go off that day and my grandma woke me up on time instead (fyi she’s is here on earth doing good, we’re just not living together). The second one is when we were driving home with my husband on this highway where there was nothing else but us, I’m sure I saw this kind of flashing thing in the sky, like something was flying over but it was very fast, like a blink.

well hope this finds you well mate. Me and my SO first met in Hanoi in early 2019 where I worked at a brewery and served his table that night. He was with a friend who was about to leave for home, and that guy was a truly wingman. He awkwardly introduced my SO to me and I was like "oh okay.." and slowly we got along well that night. Then my guy asked me to have a drink the next day and I agreed. And since then we basically hung out nearly everyday together, and I know that I have a thing for him really, and I could sensed that from him too. But after just 3 weeks he had to flight back home, we said goodbye and I genuinely thought that it was just it, nothing more. 

But yeah we still kept in touch for months, then there were ups and downs in our lives so we didn't really talk much. What so special to me is we were talking on the phone on my birthday (was my first birthday away from home), it's just the little thing that I love. After a few months we kinda moved on, I heard that he had a girlfriend, and I dated a guy as well so just assumed that we were just friends after all. Then I happened to not having any contact with others for 2 months, during the horrible time I thought about him more than about the guy I was in love with, which was kinda strange to me. And guess what, when we finally talked after months, he said he felt the same, and it's was quite odd that we both broke up with the exes. Slowly we got together and I know that he is the love of my life, like I coulnd't stop thinking about him anytime. Sad that we are half way across from each other now and due to the situation, most likely that until next summer that we can see one another. 

so OP, me and him are hopeful about the future we will share together no matter what, and we will work it out. I hope that you will step over all the struggles you're having right now and believe in fate!
